summary: Phase 136F, bounded prerequisite implementation. Implemented and independently tested only the generic Draft 2020-12 schema-validation infrastructure planned by Phase 136E, before any Stage 3 executable companion-schema authoring begins. Added jsonschema>=4.18,<5 (installed 4.25.1) to pyproject.toml -- this repository's first runtime dependency; transitive referencing/jsonschema-specifications/rpds-py/attrs are all MIT-licensed and perform no network access at runtime. New package src/pcae/schema_runtime/: a hand-written recursive-descent strict JSON parser rejecting duplicate object keys at every nesting level and non-finite numbers with JSON-Pointer instance paths (chosen over json.loads(object_pairs_hook=...), which cannot report an ancestor path for a duplicate key); a 13-code Layer-1/Layer-2 error vocabulary; immutable JsonParseResult/ShapeValidationResult/ValidationIssue/SchemaResourceInfo models with an explicit valid/invalid/infrastructure-failure outcome; an offline, containment-and-symlink-checked schema resource loader enforcing Draft 2020-12 dialect, unique $id, and meta-schema conformance; an offline-only referencing.Registry-backed registry that fails closed on any unregistered lookup, proven never to fetch even a URI-shaped $id remotely; and a generic validate_record_shape() Layer-2 shape-validation API with deterministic issue ordering and no semantic/authority claim. Resolved PREREQUISITE-136E-1: new package src/pcae/schema_resources/ (Option A -- schemas packaged inside src/pcae) with a generic, non-Stage-3 smoke schema, proven present and loadable via importlib.resources from an editable install, a built wheel, a built source distribution, and an installed wheel in an isolated venv -- no source-tree-relative fallback required. 69 new focused tests across six files, all passing; Fast Green unchanged at 4391/4391; full unmarked suite freshly run: 20128 passed, 19 failed -- all 19 failures independently reproduced identically against an isolated pre-136F worktree (commit 7a62bb54, clean venv), confirmed pre-existing and unrelated to this phase, zero regressions introduced. No Stage 3 record schema, typed model, semantic validator, authority resolver, authority state, or authority pointer was created. No cutover request, readiness package, authorization, candidate, certification, publication attempt, conflict record, or recovery journal was created. No authority epoch changed; no CLTR authority was created; no legacy authority was demoted or retired; no production lifecycle behavior changed; no execution capability was introduced. Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative; runtime remains Observed / observe / execution unavailable. Recommended next phase: 136G -- Validation Engine and Strict JSON Parsing Independent Verification.
